clips.title: The story
paras: In the Redridge Mountains, Lieutenant Fangore leads the Shadowhide gnolls against Lakeshire. His severed paw proves his death to Magistrate Solomon, whose bounty seeks to end the threat Fangore poses to the besieged town.

Lieutenant Fangore is a primary field commander among the Shadowhide gnolls encroaching across the Redridge Mountains. He serves the renegade mage Morganth and directs attacks on trade roads, outlying farms, and the defenses around Lake Everstill. Gnoll raiders leave no uniforms, official seals, or banners to confirm their dead, so the township authorities rely on physical proof. Magistrate Solomon demanded Fangore's paw to prove he had been executed, giving Lakeshire some relief amid the dangers closing around the town.
